rounds.proof_sketch: ModelNew creates InstanceNorm2dCustom with affine=True (default). When affine=True, self.weight and self.bias are defined nn.Parameters. The C++ dispatch checks 'weight.defined() && bias.defined()' which is TRUE, so instance_norm_forward_kernel_with_affine is called. The mutation is in instance_norm_forward_kernel (non-affine), which is only called when affine=False. Therefore, the mutated code path is never executed.
rounds.survival_reason: The mutation modifies the non-affine version of the kernel (instance_norm_forward_kernel), changing rsqrtf(variance + eps) to just (variance + eps). However, the ModelNew class instantiates InstanceNorm2dCustom with the default affine=True parameter. When affine=True, both weight and bias are created as nn.Parameter objects and passed to the CUDA function. The C++ code checks if both tensors are defined and routes to instance_norm_forward_kernel_with_affine, which is NOT mutated. The mutated kernel instance_norm_forward_kernel is only called when affine=False, which never happens under the fixed model configuration. This explains why Layer 2 testing found bitwise identical outputs across 112 rounds - the mutated code was never executed.
rounds.kill_strategy: This mutant is unkillable under the fixed model configuration because the mutation is in dead code. The only way to kill it would be to change the model configuration to use affine=False, but that would require changing the model definition which is not allowed under the testing contract.
rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing tools should perform control-flow reachability analysis before declaring mutations as potentially killable. When a mutation resides in code that is unreachable due to fixed configuration parameters (like affine=True being hardcoded in the model), the mutation should be classified as equivalent/unkillable early in the pipeline. Additionally, kernel implementations should consider whether having separate affine and non-affine kernels creates maintenance burden where mutations in one path may go undetected.
